Subscription that owns the VMs you want to see cost for.

content.json:
# StartStopV2 — Cost & Savings
Actual cost comes from **Azure Cost Management**. Start/stop activity comes from **Application Insights**. Modeled savings come from the `NoPii*` metrics emitted by the function app (only populated if you mirror centralized telemetry to your local App Insights).

## 1. Actual VM cost (Cost Management)
Daily cost of `Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines` in the selected subscription/scope.

content.title: Top VMs by cost in selected period

content.json:
## 2. Start/Stop activity (Application Insights)
From `VmExecutionsAttempted` emitted by the StartStopV2 function app.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'VmExecutionsAttempted'
| extend action  = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ActionType),
         success = tobool(customDimensions.prop__Successful),
         vm      = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ResourceName),
         rg      = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ResourceGroup),
         sub     = tostring(customDimensions.prop__SubscriptionId)
| where isempty('{ResourceGroupFilter}') or rg =~ '{ResourceGroupFilter}'
| summarize attempts = sum(value) by action, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Daily start/stop attempts by action

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'VmExecutionsAttempted'
| extend action  = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ActionType),
         success = tobool(customDimensions.prop__Successful),
         vm      = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ResourceName),
         rg      = tostring(customDimensions.prop__ResourceGroup)
| where isempty('{ResourceGroupFilter}') or rg =~ '{ResourceGroupFilter}'
| summarize Attempts = sum(value),
            Successes = sumif(value, success == true),
            Failures  = sumif(value, success == false)
            by vm, rg, action
| order by Attempts desc
content.title: Per-VM start/stop attempts (success vs failure)

content.json:
## 3. Modeled savings (NoPii metrics)
> These tiles only populate if the centralized `NoPii*` telemetry is also being written to **this** Application Insights instance. By default it goes only to Microsoft. See `CentralizedAppInsightsLogger`.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'NoPiiVirtualMachineResponsibleSavings'
| extend sub = tostring(customDimensions.TargetSubscription),
         rg  = tostring(customDimensions.TargetResourceGroup)
| where isempty('{ResourceGroupFilter}') or rg =~ '{ResourceGroupFilter}'
| summarize SavingsUSD = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1d), rg
| render columnchart
content.title: Daily modeled savings by resource group (USD)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'NoPiiVirtualMachineResponsibleDownTime'
| extend rg = tostring(customDimensions.TargetResourceGroup)
| where isempty('{ResourceGroupFilter}') or rg =~ '{ResourceGroupFilter}'
| summarize DownTimeHours = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1d), rg
| render columnchart
content.title: Daily responsible down-time (hours)

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where subscriptionId == '{TargetSubscription}'
| where isempty('{ResourceGroupFilter}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroupFilter}'
| extend powerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus),
         size       = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize),
         osType     = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)
| project name, resourceGroup, location, size, osType, powerState, id
| order by powerState asc, name asc
content.title: VMs in scope
